features.title: SSO OAuth login
features.acceptance: Launcher obtains an SSO token (authorization-code + PKCE) and the client exchanges it in authentication.Login; invalid/expired tokens are rejected with the V24 error.

features.title: Client handshake & version check
features.acceptance: machoNet handshake accepts the V24 build/protocol version, rejects mismatched builds, and establishes the session (userid, role, languageID).

features.title: Logout / session teardown
features.acceptance: authentication.Logout ends the session, saves location and triggers safe removal of the character from space.

features.title: Multi-login blocker
features.acceptance: multiLoginBlocker.Login kicks or refuses a second concurrent session on the same account per V24 rules.

features.title: Account roles & GM flag
features.acceptance: Account roles (player, GM, admin) persisted and sent in session; privileged calls gated by role.

features.title: Account bans/suspensions
features.acceptance: Banned or suspended accounts are refused at login with the correct ban message and expiry.

features.title: EULA/legal agreements
features.acceptance: Pending legal agreements must be accepted before character selection; acceptance persisted per account.

features.title: Language selection
features.acceptance: authentication.SetLanguageID persists the account language and localized strings are served accordingly.

features.title: Play-time accounting
features.acceptance: authentication.AccruedTime / AmUnderage and userSvc.GetSessionPlaytimeMinutes return real values.

features.title: Subscription / Omega time
features.acceptance: subscriptionMgr.GetSubscriptionTime and GetCloneGrade reflect account Omega expiry; expiry downgrades all characters to Alpha.

features.title: Alpha/Omega transition
features.acceptance: On Omega lapse characters keep skills but alpha-restricted skills become inactive; on renewal they reactivate immediately without relog where V24 does.

features.title: Multiple Character Training
features.acceptance: userSvc.ActivateMultiTraining consumes an MCT certificate and opens a training slot for 30 days; GetMultiCharactersTrainingSlots lists slots.

features.title: Redeem items (gifts)
features.acceptance: userSvc.GetRedeemTokens lists pending redeemables; ClaimRedeemTokens delivers items to the selected character/station.

features.title: Character resculpt token
features.acceptance: userSvc.ActivateCharacterReSculpt grants a full re-sculpt; consumption is persisted.

features.title: Launcher server status
features.acceptance: Server exposes status (online/players/version/VIP) consumed by the launcher and ESI /status/.

features.title: Login queue / population cap
features.acceptance: populationCap.GetCharacterLoadSlot and MoveCharacterToNewSystem gate entry into overloaded systems.

features.title: Steam/Epic linked accounts
features.acceptance: Logins via Steam/Epic federated identities map to the same EVE account and entitlements.

features.title: Twitch drops / federated entitlements
features.acceptance: Linked Twitch entitlements are granted as redeemable items.

features.title: Character transfer between accounts
features.acceptance: A paid character transfer moves a character and its assets to another account and enforces the cooldown/restrictions.

features.title: Regional auth variants (Serenity/Kiring)
features.acceptance: kiringMgr auth/anti-addiction paths are stubbed to report disabled for Tranquility parity.

features.title: Banned word filter
features.acceptance: bannedwords.check_words_allowed validates names/chat/search against server regex list.

features.title: Player reports
features.acceptance: ingamereport.report_* (bot, language, name, scam) are recorded for GM review.

features.title: Support petitions
features.acceptance: petitioner.CreatePetition/GetMyPetitionsEx/CancelPetition and GM claim/close flow with logs.

features.title: In-client surveys
features.acceptance: survey.GetActiveSurveyID/PerformSurveyChecks/ClaimSurveyRewards work and rewards are granted once.

features.title: Character selection list
features.acceptance: charUnboundMgr.GetCharacterInfo returns all characters on the account with portrait, location, ship, skill training and wallet summary.

features.title: Select character & enter game
features.acceptance: charUnboundMgr.SelectCharacterID builds the character session (station/structure or space) and loads inventory and ship.

features.title: Create character with doll
features.acceptance: CreateCharacterWithDoll validates name, race, bloodline, ancestry, school and doll; places the character in the starter system with a corvette.

features.title: Random valid name
features.acceptance: GetValidRandomName returns an unused name valid for the chosen bloodline.

features.title: Name validation
features.acceptance: Name uniqueness, length, character set and banned-word checks are enforced (ValidateNameEx semantics).

features.title: Starter skills
features.acceptance: New characters receive the V24 starter skill set and free SP for their race/school.

features.title: School corporation assignment
features.acceptance: New characters join their school NPC corp (e.g. State War Academy) and get its home station.

features.title: Character biomass (delete)
features.acceptance: PrepareCharacterForDelete starts the timer, CancelCharacterDeletePrepare aborts, DeleteCharacter biomasses after the delay; character becomes Doomheim.

features.title: Character slot limit
features.acceptance: An account holds at most 3 characters; creation beyond the limit is rejected (GetNumCharacters).

features.title: Paperdoll storage
features.acceptance: paperDollServer persists sculpt/doll data and returns it via GetMyPaperDollData/GetPaperDollData/Batch.

features.title: Recustomization
features.acceptance: UpdateExistingCharacterLimited allows clothing/hair changes; UpdateExistingCharacterFull requires a resculpt token.

features.title: Portrait render/upload
features.acceptance: photoUploadSvc accepts rendered portraits and image server serves them at all standard sizes.

features.title: Bloodline update
features.acceptance: charUnboundMgr.UpdateCharacterBloodline is honoured during resculpt where allowed.

features.title: Character public info
features.acceptance: charMgr.GetPublicInfo returns corp, alliance, race, bloodline, security status, birthday and portrait for show-info.

features.title: Character biography
features.acceptance: Editing the bio (SetCharacterDescription) persists and is shown on show-info.

features.title: Employment history
features.acceptance: corporationSvc.GetEmploymentRecord returns all past corps with join dates.

features.title: Owner notes
features.acceptance: charMgr.AddOwnerNote/EditOwnerNote/GetOwnerNote persist private notes on any owner.

features.title: Character sheet data
features.acceptance: Character sheet shows skills, attributes, implants, jump clones, standings, security status, kill rights, medals, decorations.

features.title: Home station
features.acceptance: home_station.get_home_station/set_home_station with remote change cooldown (get_next_remote_change_time) and candidate list.

features.title: Self-destruct to home station
features.acceptance: home_station.self_destruct_clone moves a podded character back to their home station clone.

features.title: Character cosmetic titles
features.acceptance: Earned cosmetic titles are owned, equipable and displayed next to the name.

features.title: Medal decorations
features.acceptance: Received medals appear on the character sheet with public/private visibility via SetMedalStatus.

features.title: Online status
features.acceptance: onlineStatus.GetOnlineStatus returns online state for contacts who allow it.

features.title: Safe logoff
features.acceptance: ship.SafeLogoff/AbortSafeLogoff: after 30s with no aggression the ship is removed from space instantly.

features.title: Logoff emergency warp
features.acceptance: Disconnecting in space without timers triggers emergency warp then removal after the timer.

features.title: Cohort membership
features.acceptance: charMgr.GetCohortsForCharacter/charUnboundMgr.GetCohortsForUser return cohort tags used for feature gating.

features.title: Character energy state
features.acceptance: characterEnergyMgr.GetMyEnergyState returns current energy values used by V24 features.

features.title: Character lock types
features.acceptance: GetCharacterLockType reports locks (transfer, delete pending, GM) and blocks selection when locked.

features.title: Get skill queue
features.acceptance: skillMgr2 handler GetSkillQueue returns ordered entries with start/end times.

features.title: Save skill queue
features.acceptance: SaveSkillQueue replaces the whole queue; validates prerequisites, alpha caps and max length (50 entries / 10-year window).

features.title: Real-time training engine
features.acceptance: SP accrue at (primary + secondary/2) per minute; levels complete at the right instant and OnSkillTrained fires even offline-then-login.

features.title: Pause/resume training
features.acceptance: Emptying the queue or AbortTraining pauses; restarting resumes from current SP.

features.title: SP per level
features.acceptance: Level thresholds follow 250*rank*sqrt(32)^(L-1); character SP and per-skill SP are consistent.

features.title: Skill history
features.acceptance: GetSkillHistory returns trained/injected/removed events with timestamps.

features.title: Inject skillbook
features.acceptance: InjectSkillIntoBrain consumes the book, adds the skill at level 0, and rejects already-known skills.

features.title: Prerequisite enforcement
features.acceptance: Queue and module/ship use honour required skills and levels (dogmaIM.GetRequiredSkillLevels).

features.title: Alpha skill caps
features.acceptance: Alpha characters cannot train above the alpha cap per skill; SP above cap is inactive.

features.title: Alpha training speed
features.acceptance: Alpha clones train at half speed versus Omega.

features.title: Unallocated SP
features.acceptance: ApplyFreeSkillPoints(typeID, points) applies unallocated SP to the given skill only.

features.title: Skill extractor
features.acceptance: Extractor removes 500,000 SP from chosen skills producing a Large Skill Injector; requires Omega and >5.5M SP.

features.title: Large skill injector
features.acceptance: Injection grants SP by total SP bracket (500k/400k/300k/150k).

features.title: Small skill injector
features.acceptance: Small injector grants 1/5 of the large amount.

features.title: Daily alpha injector
features.acceptance: alphaInjectorMgr.GetNextAvailableInjection enforces one per 24h for Alphas.

features.title: Non-diminishing injectors
features.acceptance: nonDiminishingInjectionMgr returns available non-diminishing injections and grants the fixed SP.

features.title: Expert Systems
features.acceptance: expertSystemMgr.ConsumeExpertSystem grants temporary skills for the duration; GetMyExpertSystems/RemoveMyExpertSystem work; expiry removes the skills.

features.title: Skill plans
features.acceptance: Personal/corp/certified skill plans are stored, shared and tracked.

features.title: Certificates
features.acceptance: certificateMgr reports certificate levels derived from trained skills.

features.title: Skill bonuses in dogma
features.acceptance: Trained skill levels modify ship/module attributes via dogma.

features.title: Cerebral accelerators
features.acceptance: Accelerator boosters raise all attributes for their duration, affecting training speed.

features.title: Skill offline catch-up
features.acceptance: On login the server credits training that completed while offline in the correct order.

features.title: Obsolete skill refund
features.acceptance: Removed/obsolete skills refund SP as unallocated SP.

features.title: Character attributes
features.acceptance: Five attributes (Int/Mem/Per/Will/Cha) derived from base + remap + implants + accelerators.

features.title: Neural remap
features.acceptance: RespecCharacter redistributes points within limits; one remap per year plus bonus remaps.

features.title: Bonus remaps
features.acceptance: Bonus remaps are consumable at any time and counted separately.

features.title: Plug in implant
features.acceptance: Implant plugging requires skill, occupies its slot, refuses occupied slots and applies dogma effects.

features.title: Remove implant
features.acceptance: Removing an implant destroys it (no unplugging back to inventory).

features.title: Implant set bonuses
features.acceptance: Pirate sets (Crystal, Snake, Halo, Ascendancy, etc.) apply set multipliers.

features.title: Implants lost on pod death
features.acceptance: Pod death destroys active-clone implants.

features.title: Consume booster
features.acceptance: Boosters occupy booster slots, apply bonuses for their duration and expire.

features.title: Booster side effects
features.acceptance: Each side effect rolls by chance; Nanite Control and Neurotoxin Recovery reduce chance/penalty.

features.title: Booster contraband
features.acceptance: Contraband boosters can be confiscated by customs in high-sec.

features.title: Pod respawn
features.acceptance: Podded characters wake in their medical clone at the home station with a new capsule.

features.title: Install jump clone
features.acceptance: jumpCloneSvc.InstallCloneInStation/Structure requires Infomorph Psychology slots and standing/structure service.

features.title: Clone jump
features.acceptance: CloneJump swaps to a clone at another location; requires being docked, 24h cooldown reduced by Infomorph Synchronizing.

features.title: Destroy jump clone
features.acceptance: DestroyInstalledClone removes the clone and its implants.

features.title: Name jump clone
features.acceptance: SetJumpCloneName persists a label.

features.title: Ship clone vat bay
features.acceptance: OfferShipCloneInstallation/AcceptShipCloneInstallation installs clones in Titan/Rorqual/etc. clone bays.

features.title: Clone state query
features.acceptance: GetCloneState/GetStationCloneState/GetShipCloneState return accurate clones, implants and timers.

features.title: Structure clone bay
features.acceptance: Clone bay service on Upwell structures is required and access-list gated.

features.title: Clone loss with structure
features.acceptance: Clones in a destroyed structure are moved home (implants lost) per V24 rules.

features.title: Board ship in hangar
features.acceptance: ship.Board makes the ship active, updates session shipid and fires ProcessActiveShipChanged.

features.title: Board ship in space
features.acceptance: Boarding an unpiloted owned ship within range in space transfers the capsule.

features.title: Eject from ship
features.acceptance: ship.Eject leaves the ship abandoned in space and the pilot in a capsule.

features.title: Assemble ship
features.acceptance: ship.AssembleShip turns a packaged hull into a singleton ship.

features.title: Repackage items
features.acceptance: repackagingSvc.RepackageItems repackages undamaged, empty ships/modules; refuses fitted/damaged items.

features.title: Rename ship
features.acceptance: SetShipName persists and shows on overview/show-info.

features.title: Free corvette
features.acceptance: dogmaIM.CreateNewbieShip gives a racial corvette when docked in a capsule, at most once per cooldown.

features.title: Board from ship hangar remotely
features.acceptance: ship.BoardStoredShip boards a ship from a structure/ship maintenance bay.

features.title: Ship maintenance bay
features.acceptance: Carriers/Orca/Rorqual/Titans store assembled ships; fleet members can access per settings.

features.title: Fleet hangar
features.acceptance: Fleet hangar access rules for fleet/corp members.

features.title: Specialized holds
features.acceptance: Ore, ice, gas, mineral, PI, ammo, fuel, infrastructure, mobile depot holds accept only matching item groups.

features.title: Cargo capacity
features.acceptance: Cargo moves refuse overflow by volume; packaged volumes respected.

features.title: Repair shop
features.acceptance: Station/structure repair service quotes and repairs hull/armor/module damage for ISK.

features.title: T3D modes
features.acceptance: shipStanceMgr.SetShipStance switches Defense/Sharpshooter/Propulsion modes with a cooldown; mode bonuses applied.

features.title: Ship tree data
features.acceptance: Ship tree UI shows all hulls by faction/class with skill requirements and mastery.

features.title: Masteries
features.acceptance: Mastery level per hull computed from trained certificates.

features.title: Kill marks
features.acceptance: shipKillCounter.GetItemKillCountPlayer returns kills recorded for the hull.

features.title: Insure from hangar
features.acceptance: Insurance is purchasable from the ship context menu (see insurance rows).

features.title: Ship configuration
features.acceptance: ship.GetShipConfiguration/ConfigureShip control maintenance bay/fleet hangar access flags.

features.title: Self-destruct
features.acceptance: ship.SelfDestruct destroys the ship after 2 minutes; AbortSelfDestruct cancels; produces a killmail.

features.title: Jettison cargo
features.acceptance: ship.Jettison creates a jettison container in space (one per 3 minutes per pilot) with ownership flags.

features.title: Launch ship from wreck/container
features.acceptance: eject.LaunchShipOrContainerFromWreckOrContainer launches an assembled ship from a container into space.

features.title: Fit module
features.acceptance: Fitting a module checks slot type, slot count, CPU, powergrid, calibration, group/fit limits, and skills.

features.title: Unfit module
features.acceptance: Unfitting returns the module to cargo/hangar; only allowed docked (except fitting service in space).

features.title: Rigs
features.acceptance: Rigs consume calibration, size must match hull, unfitting destroys the rig; drawback penalties apply.

features.title: T3 subsystems
features.acceptance: Strategic cruisers require exactly one subsystem per type; slot layout updates.

features.title: Max group fitted
features.acceptance: Modules with maxGroupFitted/maxGroupOnline (e.g. one DCU, one cloak) are enforced.

features.title: Ship-specific limits
features.acceptance: Modules restricted to certain hulls (canFitShipGroup/Type) enforced.

features.title: Online/offline modules
features.acceptance: SetModuleOnline/TakeModuleOffline; onlining needs 75% cap in space and CPU/PG headroom.

features.title: Saved fittings
features.acceptance: charFittingMgr/corpFittingMgr/allianceFittingMgr save, list, delete and share fittings with limits.

features.title: Fit from saved fitting
features.acceptance: ship.FitShips applies a saved fitting from available hangar items and reports missing items.

features.title: Community fittings
features.acceptance: corpFittingMgr.GetCommunityFittings returns CCP-curated fits.

features.title: Fitting in space
features.acceptance: Refit allowed near carriers/Orcas/mobile depots/structures with fitting services.

features.title: Load ammo/charges
features.acceptance: dogmaIM.LoadAmmo loads compatible charges respecting capacity, with reload time.

features.title: Unload ammo
features.acceptance: UnloadAmmo returns charges to cargo/hangar.

features.title: Weapon grouping
features.acceptance: LinkWeapons/LinkAllWeapons/UnlinkModule/PeelAndLink/MergeModuleGroups group identical turrets/launchers.

features.title: Overheating
features.acceptance: Overloaded modules gain bonuses, deal heat damage to themselves and adjacent racks; burnt modules go offline.

features.title: Module repair
features.acceptance: Damaged modules are repaired with nanite paste in space or at repair service.

features.title: Fitting simulation
features.acceptance: Client-side simulation works with server-provided type/dogma data (no server state).

features.title: Stacking penalties
features.acceptance: Same-attribute multipliers stack-penalized with exp(-(n/2.67)^2).

features.title: Dogma modifier engine
features.acceptance: All V24 modifierInfo operations (pre/post assign/add/mul/div/percent) for item, location, owner-required-skill and group modifiers.

features.title: Attribute sync to client
features.acceptance: Changed attributes are pushed via OnModuleAttributeChanges/OnGodmaShipEffect.

features.title: Godma location priming
features.acceptance: Docking/undocking primes godma for the location (ProcessGodmaPrimeLocation).

features.title: Module activation cycle
features.acceptance: Activate/Deactivate with cycle time, capacitor cost, repeat count and deactivation at cycle end.

features.title: Reactivation delay
features.acceptance: Modules with moduleReactivationDelay cannot reactivate early.

features.title: Capacitor recharge
features.acceptance: Cap regenerates per the EVE curve (peak at 25%).

features.title: Capacitor usage accounting
features.acceptance: Module cap use, neutralizing and boosting adjust capacitor correctly.

features.title: Passive shield recharge
features.acceptance: Shield regenerates per the recharge curve (peak at ~25%).

features.title: Target locking
features.acceptance: Lock time from scan resolution vs signature radius; max targets/range limits; OnTarget notifications.

features.title: Lock breaking
features.acceptance: Locks drop on cloaking, warp, out of range, ECM jam.

features.title: Sensor strength
features.acceptance: Racial sensor strength used for ECM and probe scanning.

features.title: Resistances
features.acceptance: Shield/armor/hull resistances reduce damage by type.

features.title: Signature radius effects
features.acceptance: Signature radius affects lock time, missile application, turret tracking and probe strength.

features.title: Velocity and agility
features.acceptance: Max velocity, inertia and mass determine acceleration and align time.

features.title: System-wide effects
features.acceptance: Wormhole effects, Pochven/insurgency and metaliminal storms apply system dbuffs (OnSystemWideEffectAdd).

features.title: Dynamic buffs (dbuff)
features.acceptance: Command bursts, storms, and other dbuff collections apply with max/min aggregation and expire.

features.title: Weapons timer
features.acceptance: Activating offensive modules sets a 60s weapons timer blocking docking/jumping.

features.title: Ship role/bonus effects
features.acceptance: Hull bonuses per skill level and role bonuses apply from SDE effects.

features.title: Hybrid turrets (blasters/railguns)
features.acceptance: Blasters and railguns consume hybrid charges and deal kin/therm damage per turret formula; damage notifications emitted.

features.title: Projectile turrets (autocannons/artillery)
features.acceptance: Projectile ammo damage types/ranges applied; no cap use.

features.title: Energy turrets (pulse/beam)
features.acceptance: Lasers use cap and frequency crystals; T2 crystals degrade; faction crystals damage per cycle.

features.title: Turret hit chance formula
features.acceptance: Hit chance = 0.5^((tracking term)^2 + (range term)^2) with optimal/falloff; wrecking hits at 1%.

features.title: Entropic disintegrators
features.acceptance: Triglavian disintegrators spool damage multiplier per cycle on the same target, reset on target change.

features.title: Vorton projectors
features.acceptance: EDENCOM arc weapons chain damage to nearby targets with arc range/count.

features.title: Missile launchers
features.acceptance: Rockets/LML/HML/HAM/cruise/torpedo/XL launchers fire missile entities with flight time and velocity.

features.title: Missile damage application
features.acceptance: Damage scaled by explosion radius/velocity vs target sig/speed with DRF formula.

features.title: Defender missiles
features.acceptance: Defender missiles target incoming missiles.

features.title: FoF missiles
features.acceptance: Auto-targeting missiles pick aggressors while jammed.

features.title: Smartbombs
features.acceptance: Area damage centered on ship; CONCORD response in high-sec; hits all including fleet in range.

features.title: Bombs (stealth bomber)
features.acceptance: Bomb launchers fire bombs that detonate at range for AoE damage; lockbreaker/void bombs special effects; not in high-sec.

features.title: Titan doomsdays
features.acceptance: superWeaponMgr.ActivateSinglePointTargetedModule/ActivateSlashModule: single-target and lance doomsdays with warmup and delays.

features.title: Capital weapons & HAW
features.acceptance: XL turrets/launchers and High Angle Weapons apply per capital formulas.

features.title: Breacher pods
features.acceptance: Breacher pod launchers apply % and flat HP DoT that does not stack per target.

features.title: Damage modifiers
features.acceptance: Gyrostabilizer, heat sink, magnetic field stabilizer, BCU, entropic radiation sink, drone damage amp, vorton tuning apply ROF/damage with stacking.

features.title: Tracking computers/enhancers & missile guidance
features.acceptance: TC/TE/MGC/MGE modify tracking/optimal/falloff/missile stats; scripts change bonus.

features.title: Shield boosters
features.acceptance: Local shield booster restores shield per cycle; X-Large/capital variants.

features.title: Ancillary shield boosters
features.acceptance: ASB runs on cap boosters with bonus, falls back to capacitor when empty; reload 60s.

features.title: Shield extenders/hardeners/amplifiers
features.acceptance: Passive extenders add HP; active hardeners and amplifiers raise resists.

features.title: Armor repairers
features.acceptance: Local reps restore armor at cycle end.

features.title: Ancillary armor repairers
features.acceptance: AAR triples rep with nanite paste loaded.

features.title: Plates/hardeners/EANM
features.acceptance: Plates add HP+mass; active/passive hardeners raise resists.

features.title: Reactive armor hardener
features.acceptance: RAH shifts resists toward incoming damage types each cycle.

features.title: Damage control
features.acceptance: DCU adds hull/armor/shield resists, one per ship.

features.title: Hull repairers & bulkheads
features.acceptance: Hull reps and reinforced bulkheads function.

features.title: Assault damage control
features.acceptance: ADC grants a burst of resists with reactivation delay on assault ships.

features.title: Remote shield boosters
features.acceptance: Remote shield transfer heals target shield; logi aggression flags applied.

features.title: Remote armor repairers
features.acceptance: Remote armor reps heal target armor; mutadaptive spool-up for Triglavian.

features.title: Remote hull repairers
features.acceptance: Remote hull reps heal target structure.

features.title: Remote capacitor transmitter
features.acceptance: Transfers capacitor to target.

features.title: Capacitor boosters
features.acceptance: Inject capacitor from charges with reload.

features.title: Cap batteries/rechargers/power relays/flux coils
features.acceptance: Passive capacitor modules modify capacity/recharge; batteries resist neuts.

features.title: ECM jammers
features.acceptance: Jam chance = jammer strength/sensor strength; jammed ship loses locks for 20s; burst jammers AoE.

features.title: Remote sensor dampeners
features.acceptance: Reduce target lock range or scan resolution per script.

features.title: Weapon disruptors
features.acceptance: Tracking disruptors and guidance disruptors reduce turret/missile stats per script.

features.title: Target painters
features.acceptance: Increase target signature radius.

features.title: Stasis webifiers
features.acceptance: Reduce target velocity with range/falloff; grapplers.

features.title: Warp disruptors/scramblers
features.acceptance: Apply warp scramble strength vs warp core strength; scramblers stop MWD/MJD.

features.title: Energy neutralizers
features.acceptance: Drain target capacitor (and nosferatu transfer to self).

features.title: ECCM/sensor boosters/signal amps
features.acceptance: Increase sensor strength, lock range, scan res, max targets.

features.title: Burst jammer
features.acceptance: AoE ECM affecting all ships in range.

features.title: Burst projectors
features.acceptance: Area EWAR projectors (ECM, weapon disruption, dampening, warp disruption, target illumination) on Black Ops/Recons.

features.title: Interdiction sphere launcher
features.acceptance: Dictor bubbles spawn a warp disruption field in null/WH; prevents warp and drags warpers.

features.title: Warp disruption field generator
features.acceptance: HIC infinite point/bubble mode with penalties.

features.title: Mobile warp disruptors
features.acceptance: Anchorable bubbles in nullsec with deploy timers.

features.title: Afterburners
features.acceptance: Increase max velocity; mass additive.

features.title: Microwarpdrives
features.acceptance: Increase speed and signature radius; cap penalty; disabled by scrams.

features.title: Micro jump drive
features.acceptance: MJD jumps 100 km forward after 12s spool; field variant jumps nearby ships.

features.title: Nanofibers/overdrives/inertial stabs
features.acceptance: Passive speed/agility modules.

features.title: Warp core stabilizers
features.acceptance: Add warp core strength with lock range/scan penalties.

features.title: Interdiction nullification
features.acceptance: Nullified ships ignore bubbles.

features.title: Cloaking devices
features.acceptance: Cloaks fail within 2 km of objects, block locking, reduce speed; covert cloaks allow warping cloaked.

features.title: Decloak rules

features.title: Covert ops cloak
features.acceptance: Covert hulls warp cloaked; no targeting delay penalty variants.

features.title: Cynosural field generator
features.acceptance: Lights a cyno beacon for 5 min (non-covert), consumes Liquid Ozone, fixes ship in place.

features.title: Covert cyno
features.acceptance: Covert cynos allow Black Ops and covert jump portals.

features.title: Industrial cyno
features.acceptance: Industrial cyno allows jump freighters and rorquals only.

features.title: Cyno jammer
features.acceptance: Sovereignty Pharolux jammer blocks cynos in system (beyonce.GetCynoJammerState).

features.title: Jump portal generator
features.acceptance: Titans/Black Ops bridge fleet members to a cyno with fuel cost and range.

features.title: Siege module
features.acceptance: Dreadnought siege: bonuses, immobility, remote assistance immunity, cycle 5 min.

features.title: Triage module
features.acceptance: FAX triage: rep bonuses, immobile, cannot receive remote reps.

features.title: Bastion module
features.acceptance: Marauder bastion: resists, range, immune to EWAR, immobile.

features.title: Industrial core
features.acceptance: Orca/Rorqual core enables boosts/compression, makes ship immobile.

features.title: Command bursts
features.acceptance: Burst charges apply fleet dbuffs (shield, armor, skirmish, info, mining) to fleet in range with duration.

features.title: Salvagers

features.title: Tractor beams
features.acceptance: Pull wrecks/cans to ship at tractor velocity; ownership checks.

features.title: Data/relic analyzers
features.acceptance: Start hacking minigame on data/relic cans.

features.title: Cargo scanner
features.acceptance: Show target cargo contents.

features.title: Ship scanner
features.acceptance: Show target fitting and capacitor.

features.title: Survey scanner
